topics.title: Granular Time Logging & Project Task Allocation
topics.objective: Record billable hours across client projects, billable vs non-billable codes, and time approval gates.
topics.example: TimeEntry: { consultant_id: 'C-42', project_id: 'P-99', hours: 7.5, billable: true }
topics.exercise: Build a timesheet submission form validating weekly hour totals and preventing overlapping time entries.

topics.title: Hierarchical Approval Workflows & Notification Loops
topics.objective: Route submitted timesheets to department managers with bulk approval and rejection change requests.
topics.exercise: Implement an approval state machine sending automated email reminders for pending Friday timesheet signoffs.

topics.title: Automated Invoice Generation & Rate Card Calculations
topics.objective: Aggregate approved monthly hours and calculate tiered consultant billing rates with sales tax rules.
topics.exercise: Write an invoice generation service aggregating hours into clean itemized PDF client invoices.

topics.title: Payment Gateway Integration (Stripe / ACH / Wire)
topics.objective: Enable direct client online invoice settlement via ACH bank debit and corporate credit card rails.
topics.exercise: Integrate Stripe Invoicing webhooks marking timesheets as Settled upon invoice.payment_succeeded event.

topics.title: Billing Audit Trails & Contractor Tax Reporting (1099/GST)
topics.objective: Maintain immutable audit trails for dispute resolution and export quarterly contractor tax summaries.
topics.example: AuditTrail: { action: 'HOURS_MODIFIED', before: 8.0, after: 7.5, modified_by: 'Mgr. Smith' }
topics.exercise: Generate automated year-end contractor earnings reports compliant with 1099 and GST reporting requirements.
